A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study, with the same title, authors, and complete appendices A–E. Text comparison and rendered-page checks support a reliable comparison; all appendix pages are unchanged.

before.justification: v1 reports original neural-network training experiments, optimizer comparisons, and neural-collapse measurements in Section 3, Tables 2–3, and Appendix D.

after.justification: v4 retains the same original empirical results, including the main optimizer experiments and the additional ImageNet, UFM, and vision-transformer experiments in Appendix D.

M1.justification: The optimizer update rules, architectures, training objectives, and Adam/AdamW weight-decay interpolation procedure in Section 3.4 are unchanged. No method component is added or revised.

E1.justification: Both versions retain MNIST, FashionMNIST, CIFAR10, and ImageNet1K coverage, together with the separable-data and UFM experiments. No evaluated task, dataset, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The main comparisons retain SGD, SGDW, Adam, AdamW, Signum, and SignumW. Appendix comparisons are also unchanged, including Adam versus AdamW on ImageNet and Adam, AdamW, and SGD for vision transformers.

E3.justification: Section 3.1 and Appendix D retain the same hyperparameter sweeps, training budgets, learning-rate schedules, metrics, and run-selection criteria. The distinct UFM, ImageNet, and vision-transformer protocols are also unchanged.

E4.justification: The weight-decay interpolation, extended-training, normalized-NC0, momentum, and zero-weight-decay ablations are retained unchanged. The correlation and singular-value analyses in Appendix D are likewise identical.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same standard-deviation bands across hyperparameter configurations. Table 6 retains the same regression sample counts, standard errors, confidence intervals, and statistical tests; no run-count, seed, or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, plotted results, and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout. For example, Table 2 reports NC0 of 0.34 for Adam and 5.33 for AdamW in both versions, and Appendix D.4.10 retains the best ViT test accuracy of 83.67%.

T1.justification: Proposition 2.1, Theorems 3.1–3.4, the definitions in Appendix B, and the proofs in Appendix E are unchanged. Adding 'on NC0' to Table 1's caption clarifies its subject without revising mathematical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about optimizer-dependent neural collapse, weight-decay coupling, momentum, and the NC0 diagnostic. The new Author Contributions section assigns credit rather than changing scientific contributions.

C2.justification: Section 4 retains the same interpretations of practical NC metrics, partial collapse, and generalization, together with the same limitations of the simplified theory and last-layer analysis. Appendix interpretations and qualifications are unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix D retains identical hyperparameters, implementation and code-source information, hardware, and training-time disclosures. The added affiliation, funding acknowledgment, and author roles provide no new technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning, including Appendix C, are unchanged. References move between pages 11 and 12 because of the added disclosures; no cited work is added or removed.

P1.justification: v4 adds an IDEAS Research Institute affiliation and short Acknowledgments and Author Contributions sections before the references. It also clarifies Table 1's caption with 'on NC0'; the scientific narrative and appendix structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 1's caption changes, and the added affiliation and disclosures cause localized text reflow on the opening and reference pages. No figures or tables are added, removed, or redrawn; all appendix layouts are identical.

improvement.justification: v4 adds attribution and funding disclosures and slightly clarifies Table 1's caption. These localized editorial additions leave the scientific explanation, empirical evidence, mathematical arguments, reproducibility information, and limitations unchanged, so overall paper quality remains essentially the same.
